pages.text: Storms in Alterra have a life of their own. They are not vanilla rain: each kind has its own schedule, builds up over a minute or so, holds, and fades. Every region of the world keeps its own, so one desert can be in a sandstorm while another is clear.

Deserts and badlands: sandstorms - dust racing along the ground, a haze over the screen, a close sandy fog. Snowy lands: blizzards - driven snow and a white-out. Misty places: fog banks, thickest at dawn. Blossom woods: storms of petals.
Flower fields: pollen drifts by on warm, clear days. Burnt lands: ash falls. On clear nights the snowy lands show an aurora. The bigger storms howl. Indoors the effects fade away.
Every effect has a switch (and a particle amount) in the Weather settings, and they step aside by themselves when another weather or fog mod is installed.
